cues.text: Who does your team call first?
No more dealing out leads by hand on WhatsApp every morning.
Your executive signs in, and the day is already laid out.
Call these first. Never contacted, and longest wait sits on top.
Today's site visits show with times, plus any left open earlier.
Leads going quiet get flagged, and each item clears itself when done.
The first sixty seconds, sorted Book a demo.
